ahead.description: Commits ahead of the default branch. `null` when not computable.

producedBy.description: Dev agent/module owning the branch (RN-152), when the name matches `feature/task-XXXXXXXX` and the task/module are still resolvable. `null` for a user's manual branch or for `main`/`dev`/`qa`.

agentId.description: agent_id of the dev who created the branch (`dev-<module>`/`dev-<module>-2`, RN-087).

moduleId.description: Module name, from the project's current `module_map`.

truncated.description: The list was cut at the enriched-branches cap.

400.description: Path outside the project scope (RN-095), malformed ref, or a search term that is too short or too long.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project without a provisioned repository, or a nonexistent ref/path/PR.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.

501.description: The project's provider does not declare the operation's capability — `listTree`, `pullRequestDiff`, `blame`, `pullRequestsList`, or `branchesDetailed`. A capability is only declared once proven by the contract suite, so this is a legitimate response, not a defect.
